userStories.title: Add pre-flight subtitle availability check using --list-subs
acceptanceCriteria: Add list_available_subtitles(video_id) method to CaptionFetcher that runs yt-dlp --list-subs --skip-download
Parse the output to detect available manual and auto-generated subtitle tracks
Return a structured result with available_manual_languages, available_auto_languages, has_any_subtitles
Integrate check into fetch_captions() to fail fast when no subtitles exist before trying formats
Add unit test verifying pre-flight check prevents unnecessary format attempts
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (core functionality). IMPLEMENTED: Added SubtitleAvailabilityResult dataclass and list_available_subtitles() method to CaptionFetcher. The method wraps list_available_languages() and returns structured result with available_manual_languages, available_auto_languages, has_any_subtitles. Pre-flight check was already integrated into _fetch_subtitle() at line 4246. Added 5 unit tests in tests/test_caption_preflight.py covering all acceptance criteria. All 12 tests pass.

userStories.title: Add transcription retry with exponential backoff for GPU errors
acceptanceCriteria: Add is_transient_error() function that detects CUDA out-of-memory and ctranslate2 errors
Implement retry logic in transcribe_video() with configurable max_retries (default 2)
Use exponential backoff (1s, 2s) between retries for transient errors only
Clear CUDA cache between retries to help recover from OOM
Add test verifying retry behavior for transient vs permanent errors
userStories.notes: IMPLEMENTED: (1) is_transient_error() already exists in src/transcription/exceptions.py lines 68-95 with TRANSIENT_ERROR_PATTERNS including 'cuda', 'out of memory', 'ctranslate2' at lines 40-50. (2) Retry logic in transcribe_video() at parallel_processor.py lines 372-424 with max_retries=2 parameter (line 320). (3) Exponential backoff at line 420: delay = base_delay * (2 ** attempt) gives 1s, 2s with base_delay=1.0. (4) Added _clear_cuda_cache() function at lines 29-46 that calls torch.cuda.empty_cache() and torch.cuda.synchronize(), called before sleep in retry loop at line 425. (5) TestTranscriptionRetry class in tests/test_transcription_parallel_processor.py lines 944-1166 with 7 tests covering transient retries, permanent error rejection, CUDA cache clearing. Also fixed unrelated mock_config fixture to include audio_extraction_workers. All 34 tests pass.
